title: Conformational dynamics study of TfR1 upon transferrin binding via NMA and MD simulations.
authors: Zemmouche, Madjid; Falque, Gabriel; Cadet, Frederic; Gardebien, Fabrice; Etchebest, Catherine
one_liner_zh: 该文通过NMA和MD模拟研究转铁蛋白受体TfR1与配体Tf结合前后的构象动态，属于广义蛋白-配体互作而非TF-DNA体系，但方法（MD/NMA）可迁移至TF-DNA互作建模，故给5分。
abstract: The Human transferrin receptor 1 (TfR1) mediates cellular iron uptake via clathrin-mediated endocytosis of transferrin (Tf) and is an important therapeutic target, particularly in anti-cancer strategies. Understanding its structural dynamics is crucial to avoid disrupting ligand-induced internalization. In this study, we constructed a complete model of the TfR1 dimer and docked two Tf structures to form the TfR1-2Tf complex. Conformational dynamics of apo TfR1 and the TfR1-2Tf complex were investigated using normal mode analysis and molecular dynamics simulations, including solvent and membrane environments. In apo TfR1, the molecular stalk and apical subdomain were highly flexible, whereas the helical and protease-like subdomains displayed moderate mobility. Tf binding stabilizes the stalk and upper helical subdomain, limiting large tilting motions, while preserving hinge regions necessary for conformational changes. Dynamic cross-correlation analysis showed that Tf binding also enhances coordination between subdomains. Novel interface residues mediating interactions between the Tf N-lobes and the TfR1 stalk were identified. These findings provide a valuable structural basis for rational ligand design targeting TfR1 without disrupting its functional dynamics, offering insights for improved drug delivery and receptor inhibition strategies.
abstract_zh: 人转铁蛋白受体1（TfR1）通过转铁蛋白（Tf）的网格蛋白介导内吞作用介导细胞铁摄取，是重要的治疗靶点，尤其在抗癌策略中。理解其结构动力学对于避免干扰配体诱导的内化至关重要。在本研究中，我们构建了TfR1二聚体的完整模型，并对接两个Tf结构以形成TfR1-2Tf复合物。通过简正模式分析和分子动力学模拟，包括溶剂和膜环境，研究了apo TfR1和TfR1-2Tf复合物的构象动力学。在apo TfR1中，分子柄和顶端亚结构域高度灵活，而螺旋样和蛋白酶样亚结构域表现出中等流动性。Tf结合稳定了柄和上部螺旋亚结构域，限制了大倾斜运动，同时保留了构象变化所需的铰链区域。动态互相关分析显示，Tf结合还增强了亚结构域之间的协调性。鉴定了介导Tf N-叶与TfR1柄之间相互作用的新界面残基。这些发现为针对TfR1的合理配体设计提供了宝贵的结构基础，且不破坏其功能动力学，为改进药物递送和受体抑制策略提供了见解。
